maria: Quick sync — new candidate for onboarding: iridium-11b. TL;DR: strong convo eval numbers on our devset, unknown quant behavior. Can we gate this week?

samir: Saw the eval dump — fp16 median latency ~42ms @ seq128 on A100, ppl delta -0.7 vs current serving model. Link to perf table: https://internal/redwood/evals/iridium-11b (private)

cheng: PTQ int8 looked noisy in preliminary runs, saw ~12% regression on our toxicity check. QAT after a couple epochs looks much better but needs 3 seeds to be confident.

aj: infra note — Dedicated pools are saturated until Mon. We can run smoke/quant on spot preemptible machines; cost estimate for the PTQ sweep ~ $450.

maria: Proposed quick-prio checklist for this week — short and executable: 
- minimal quality gate: no >5% regression on core checks (toxicity, hallucination score)
- latency target: <=1.2x current 95p for seq128 FP16
- cost delta: expected per-token cost <=1.1x after quantization
- infra feasibility: spot/pack plan OK

Also proposed scoring formula (rough):
```
priority_score = 0.4*quality_delta + 0.3*latency_improvement + 0.2*cost_savings + 0.1*strategic
```
Where quality_delta is normalized (higher = better), latency_improvement positive if faster.

samir: +1 on the checklist. Suggest splitting quality_delta into separate buckets (toxicity, conv-quality, math) so we can flag targeted regressions early.

cheng: I can run the PTQ vs QAT experiments today. Will post a short summary. Smoke command I'll use: `python bench.py --model iridium-11b --quant ptq --seq 512 --bs 32 --device cuda`

aj: I'll provision spot nodes after samir/ cheng confirm start. Ping me with exact resource tags and expiry.

deploy-bot: Job queued: quant-smoke-iridium-11b-2026-03-20. Status: queued -> running.

maria: OK team — plan: samir owns the quality pass, cheng runs quant experiments, aj handles ephemeral infra. Target gate decision by Fri COB. I'll open intake ticket and attach this thread. :raised_hands:

samir: I'll start the full quality run EOD and post results as a short table + hitlist for any regressions.

cheng: kicked off 3 PTQ seeds (small sweep). Will report latencies + regression deltas in-thread.

aj: spots provisioned, tags `iridium-prio-2026`. ETA ~10m.

maria: Thanks — creating ticket #2345 and adding the quick checklist. If we hit any >5% regression, hold rollout and escalate to model-onboard. :thumbsup:
